title: STM32 外部中断 EXTI
goal: 掌握 NVIC 优先级配置与 EXTI 边沿中断回调，理解中断与轮询的差异。
doc:
实验平台（虚实结合）：实物实验采用 STC89C52RC 最小系统板（京东开发板）与 STM32F407 最小系统板（京东开发板）。

实验10 STM32 外部中断 EXTI

接线说明

KEY1→PA0（下降沿触发 EXT0），PE0 接 D1 作中断响应指示。

CubeMX 配置

  1. PA0 → GPIO_EXTI0，模式 Pull-up，触发 Falling edge；
  2. NVIC → EXTI line0 interrupt 使能，抢占优先级 1；
  3. PE0 → GPIO_Output。

关键代码

void HAL_GPIO_EXTI_Callback(uint16_t GPIO_Pin) {
  if (GPIO_Pin == GPIO_PIN_0) {
    HAL_GPIO_TogglePin(GPIOE, GPIO_PIN_0);   // 每按一次翻转
  }
}
/* main 中主循环可为空：响应完全由中断完成 */

验收标准

按 KEY1 一次 D1 翻转一次，主循环空转也能响应。

思考

中断服务函数里为什么不宜调用 HAL_Delay？多个中断同时到来时 NVIC 如何排定顺序？

工程与烧录流程（HEX 导入模式）

  1. STM32CubeMX 新建工程：MCU 选 STM32F407ZGT6（与开发板一致），时钟树 HSI 8MHz → SYSCLK 8MHz（不进 PLL，与平台仿真时钟一致）；
  2. 按本实验要求配置外设（GPIO/TIM/USART…），Project Manager 选 STM32CubeIDE 或 MDK-ARM V5 → Generate Code；
  3. 用 STM32CubeIDE（勾选 Create flash image 生成 .hex）或 Keil MDK（Options → Output 勾选 Create HEX File）编译，得到 .hex；
  4. 在本系统顶部「📂 加载 HEX」导入归档（可「💾 保存 HEX」提交），并用 STM32CubeProgrammer / mcuisp 烧录实物板验证；
  5. 注意：本平台内置 Cortex-M4 指令级内核，编译好的 HEX 可直接「📂 加载 HEX」导入并「▶ 运行」——GPIO/USART/SysTick/EXTI 的读写与中断均可观测；本实验聚焦 GPIO 与 USART 的寄存器级行为；定时器与模拟量采集由配套硬件实验完成。平台仿真时钟固定 8MHz（时钟按 8MHz 固定配置运行），请在 CubeMX 里保持 HSI 8MHz 直驱 SYSCLK（不进 PLL），这样代码里的 HAL_Delay 等延时在平台上与实物节奏一致；若导入的固件按更高主频配置，其延时会在平台上按比例放慢，可用右上角倍速加快。

⚡ 本电路为预接线参考：VDD/VSS 已接电源端子，外设已按实验要求接好；可自由拆改、用 R 键旋转、双击设网络标号。

goalEn: NVIC priority configuration and the EXTI edge-interrupt callback; interrupts vs. polling.
docEn:
Experiment platform (virtual–physical): the physical labs use the STC89C52RC minimal system board (JD.com) and the STM32F407 minimal system board (JD.com).

Lab 10 — STM32 external interrupt EXTI

Wiring

KEY1→PA0 (EXTI0, falling edge); PE0 drives D1 as the interrupt-response indicator.

CubeMX configuration

  1. PA0 → GPIO_EXTI0, mode Pull-up, trigger Falling edge;
  2. NVIC → enable EXTI line0 interrupt, preemption priority 1;
  3. PE0 → GPIO_Output.

Key code

void HAL_GPIO_EXTI_Callback(uint16_t GPIO_Pin) {
  if (GPIO_Pin == GPIO_PIN_0) {
    HAL_GPIO_TogglePin(GPIOE, GPIO_PIN_0);   // toggle on every press
  }
}
/* the main loop can stay empty: the response is entirely interrupt-driven */

Acceptance

Each press of KEY1 toggles D1 once; the response still works when the main loop is busy or empty.

Reflection

Why should HAL_Delay be avoided inside an ISR? When several interrupts arrive together, how does NVIC order them?

Build & flash workflow (HEX import mode)

  1. STM32CubeMX: create a project for the STM32F407ZGT6 (matching the board); clock tree HSI 8MHz → SYSCLK 8MHz (no PLL, matching the simulator clock);
  2. Configure the peripherals required by this lab (GPIO/TIM/USART…); in Project Manager choose STM32CubeIDE or MDK-ARM V5 → Generate Code;
  3. Build with STM32CubeIDE (enable Create flash image to produce a .hex) or Keil MDK (Options → Output → Create HEX File);
  4. Import the .hex with "📂 Load HEX" in the toolbar (and "💾 Save HEX" to submit), then flash the real board with STM32CubeProgrammer / mcuisp to verify;
  5. Note: this platform embeds an instruction-level Cortex-M4 core — the built HEX can be loaded and run directly; GPIO/USART/SysTick/EXTI reads, writes and interrupts are observable. This lab focuses on register-level GPIO and USART behavior; timer and analog acquisition are verified in the companion hardware labs. The simulation clock is fixed at 8MHz (the clock runs at a fixed 8MHz configuration). Keep HSI 8MHz driving SYSCLK directly (no PLL) in CubeMX so delays such as HAL_Delay pace the same as on the real board; firmware configured for a higher clock runs proportionally slower — use the speed selector to compensate.

⚡ This circuit is pre-wired as a reference: VDD/VSS are connected to the power terminals and peripherals are wired as required; feel free to modify it, rotate parts with R, and double-click to set net labels.
